title: Cadmies Knowledge Construction Phases
definition: A systematic approach to knowledge construction, breaking down the process into distinct phases (Harvest, Relationships, Map, Gateway) that build upon each other to create a reliable and efficient pipeline.

difficulty_levels.beginner: It's like baking a cake: you mix the ingredients (Harvest), shape it (Relationships), bake it (Map), and serve it (Gateway). Each step builds on the previous one to create something delicious (knowledge).
difficulty_levels.intermediate: CADMIES Knowledge Construction Phases is a systematic approach to knowledge construction, breaking down the process into distinct phases: Harvest, Relationships, Map, and Gateway. Each phase builds upon the previous one to create a reliable and efficient pipeline.
difficulty_levels.expert: CADMIES Knowledge Construction Phases is a philosophical concept that outlines a systematic approach to knowledge construction, breaking it down into distinct phases (Harvest, Relationships, Map, Gateway) that build upon each other to create a reliable and efficient pipeline. This ensures the construction of high-quality, scientifically rigorous knowledge.
